_comment: BLG-SEC-15 / ST-04 (EPIC-02, v8.5): known-as-of-baseline snapshot for the monthly dependency-vuln-rescan.yml scheduled job. Advisory IDs listed here are treated as 'already tracked' by the workflow's dedup logic and will NOT re-trigger a new GitHub issue on every run -- only advisory IDs absent from this file are reported as 'new'. This is NOT an accepted-risk register (unlike vulnerability-scan.yml's inline CVE-2026-4539 ignore, which has explicit Cybersecurity & Trust Lead + Head of Engineering sign-off) -- these are unreviewed at baseline time and were filed as BLG-SEC-18 for Cybersecurity & Trust Lead triage. Update this file (add the advisory ID) once a finding has been reviewed and is either fixed, or a considered accept-risk decision is recorded elsewhere (e.g. inline in vulnerability-scan.yml per the CVE-2026-4539 pattern) -- do not silently let the baseline grow uncurated. ST-24 (BLG-SEC-18, EPIC-05, v8.8) update, 2026-08-16: react-router/react-router-dom's 12 advisory IDs removed below (genuinely fixed -- react-router-dom upgraded ^7.13.0 -> ^7.18.2, confirmed absent from a fresh npm audit); the remaining 29 IDs (14 packages) are recorded accept-risk per docs/security/npm_audit_baseline_review_2026-08-16.md, review-by 2027-02-16 -- no longer 'unreviewed'.

npm_audit.note: All 14 remaining are transitive dependencies of react-scripts (CRA v5 build toolchain -- webpack-dev-server/svgo/postcss/ws chain), confirmed never imported by application source (build-tooling only, never shipped to the browser). Individually risk-assessed and accept-risk-dispositioned by ST-24 (BLG-SEC-18, EPIC-05, v8.8) -- see docs/security/npm_audit_baseline_review_2026-08-16.md for owner, rationale, and 2027-02-16 review-by date. react-router/react-router-dom (previously 12 of the original 41 advisory IDs) were fixed directly by the same story (react-router-dom ^7.13.0 -> ^7.18.2) and removed from this list.
